exposure: Primary surgical repair (intraventricular rerouting with arterial switch maneuver)
cohort: A single neonate with double outlet right ventricle (non-committed ventricular septal defect type and lack of outlet septum) accompanied by right aortic arch and dextro-malposition of great arteries.
finding: Primary surgical repair via intraventricular rerouting and arterial switch maneuver was successfully performed in this particular neonate, leading to an excellent hemodynamic status.
